title: Actions related to transmission of UEAssistanceInformation message

entities.name: UEAssistanceInformation message
entities.description: RRC message used by UE to provide various assistance information to the network including delay budget reports, overheating assistance, power saving preferences, and other UE capabilities.

entities.name: OverheatingAssistance IE
entities.description: Information element containing parameters for overheating assistance including reduced component carriers, bandwidth, and MIMO layers.

entities.name: DRX-Preference IE
entities.description: Information element containing UE preferences for DRX parameters including long cycle, inactivity timer, short cycle, and short cycle timer.

entities.name: MaxBW-Preference IE
entities.description: Information element containing UE preferences for maximum aggregated bandwidth reduction for different frequency ranges.

entities.name: MaxCC-Preference IE
entities.description: Information element containing UE preferences for maximum number of secondary component carriers.

entities.name: MaxMIMO-LayerPreference IE
entities.description: Information element containing UE preferences for maximum number of MIMO layers for different frequency ranges.

entities.name: MinSchedulingOffsetPreference IE
entities.description: Information element containing UE preferences for minimum scheduling offset values (K0/K2) for cross-slot scheduling across different SCS.

entities.name: UE experiences internal overheating
entities.description: Condition where the UE detects internal overheating and needs to provide overheating assistance information.

entities.name: UE has power saving preference
entities.description: Condition where the UE has preferences for power saving configurations including DRX, bandwidth, CCs, and MIMO layers.

entities.name: UE assistance information procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE transmits UEAssistanceInformation message to provide various assistance information to the network.

relations.description: UE assistance procedure involves transmitting UEAssistanceInformation message
UEAssistanceInformation message contains OverheatingAssistance IE when UE experiences overheating
UEAssistanceInformation message contains DRX-Preference IE for power saving preferences
UEAssistanceInformation message contains MaxBW-Preference IE for bandwidth reduction preferences
UEAssistanceInformation message contains MaxCC-Preference IE for component carrier reduction preferences
UEAssistanceInformation message contains MaxMIMO-LayerPreference IE for MIMO layer reduction preferences
UEAssistanceInformation message contains MinSchedulingOffsetPreference IE for scheduling offset preferences
UE includes OverheatingAssistance IE when it experiences internal overheating condition
UE includes DRX-Preference IE when it has power saving preferences for DRX parameters
UE includes MaxBW-Preference IE when it has power saving preferences for bandwidth reduction
